name: 80026 · Lafayette, CO
findings: ZIP 80026 (Lafayette) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 67 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80026 (Lafayette) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 80026 (Lafayette) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
